verdict.rationale: Dagster ships a CLI (dg, dagster) and Docker deployment options with a webserver/daemon architecture designed for scheduled, sensor-driven, or CI-triggered runs, and probe evidence confirms the CLI installs and scaffolds/runs projects keylessly end-to-end. missing for 10: no first-party doc excerpt specifically describing a CI/CD pipeline integration (e.g. GitHub Actions example) or headless-run flags beyond dev server, and no independent report of running Dagster fully headless in a CI pipeline.
